done_when: docs/specs/one-permission-flow.md is a confirmed spec that makes a job an unattended turn on the same permission flow as chat, with the owner's 2026-10-01 decisions and a roadmap of stories

findings.body: The spec explicitly replaces CARDSIMPLE-2 and CARDSIMPLE-3, but `plans/roadmap.json:2409` and `plans/roadmap.json:2427` still mark both pending, ordered before PERMFLOW-1. Their acceptance criteria require the job-card and late-tap machinery this spec removes. Remove them from pending work or mark them superseded so the roadmap agrees with the confirmed decisions.
findings.title: Retire the roadmap stories this spec replaces

why: Scheduled jobs and chat ask for permission in five different ways, and jobs keep breaking because of it
